lines.en: My steps make the ground thud dully.
I walk along the leaning trunks.
My belly drags very low.

lines.zh: 橘色的皮在地上留亮痕。
lines.en: My orange hide leaves a bright streak.
A shrub blocks me; I shoulder it aside.

lines.zh: 每一步都比我预想的重。
lines.en: Every step lands heavier than I expect.

lines.zh: 我在赫尔维蒂的树根间挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze between the roots of Lelyetia.
After eating all the way, I walk slower.
I patrol slowly, dragging my belly.
Bones clink together inside my stomach.
I never fear stepping on traps.
I follow smells to find something to eat.
I am chewing on something from last week.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，味道很难闻。
lines.en: I burp; it smells dreadful.

lines.zh: 橘色的皮被蹭破一小块。
lines.en: A patch of my orange hide has rubbed raw.
I sit with my belly spread on the ground.
I am counting the silver coins in my gut.
Tree shadows slide across my back.
I lick the salt off my claws.
I think of nothing except eating.

lines.zh: 这身皮我还留着，别打主意。
lines.en: I am keeping this hide; do not get ideas.
A fruit falls; I do not move.
You look quite edible to me.
I stare at your backpack.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的皮，闻着像我的皮。
lines.en: The leather at your belt smells like my own hide.
I lick my lips, very slowly.
Do you start this, or shall I?
I am estimating how much you weigh.
Those boots are made of leather, are they not?

lines.zh: 你站得太高，我仰着看你。
lines.en: You stand too tall; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，得分几口。
lines.en: Something this large will take several bites.
Your eyes are moving; you are calculating.

lines.zh: 你砍在我皮上，只留白痕。
lines.en: Your blade leaves only a white line on my hide.
I am nearly impossible to knock back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我胃里叫得更响。
lines.en: That blow only made my stomach louder.

lines.zh: 你砍掉的皮，我捡起来吃。
lines.en: I pick up the hide you cut off and eat it.
That cut was far too shallow.
The wound is shallow; I cannot be bothered.
Your hands shake; mine do not.
I moved forward a little.
My blood is orange; do not rub against it.
Cut again and I will patch it with your bones.
Whatever is in your hand, I want it.
I never have too much food.
Hand it over; stop waving it at me.
Waving food is pointless; I simply want it.
I will eat you along with it.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的肚子叫了。
lines.en: That smell made my stomach growl.
Bark, bones, coins; I swallow them all.
Drop it, then step back three paces.

lines.zh: 我咬过比这更硬的东西。
lines.en: I have bitten through far harder things.
That is far too little bait.
Hit me and you are the one bouncing off.
I am almost impossible to push back.
My belly feels like a sack of sand.

lines.zh: 你用肩膀撞我，我都不晃。
lines.en: You shoulder me and I do not even sway.
I take a hit and shift half a step.
My orange hide smears all over you.
Anything that bumps into me, I eat.
Do not stand behind me.
You stepped back; your knees decided first.
We collided, and you came off worse.
We do not pair up; we pile up.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂的林子里只有吃。
lines.en: In Lelyetia's woods there is only eating.

lines.zh: 我对同类也只有一张嘴。
lines.en: Even toward my own kind I have only a mouth.
Do not speak of tenderness around me.

lines.zh: 两个掠杀者相遇，会少一个。
lines.en: When two Grobblers meet, one is fewer.
My belly matters more than my heart.
No one ever taught me how to hold anyone.
This hide of mine is for no one.
What I birth, I also eat.
You picked the wrong one; find someone else.
There were coins on the ground, so I took them.
I put it in my mouth so I will not lose it.
Can this be eaten? Let us find out.
My claws are too short to reach it.
I crouch very low when picking things up.
I chew twice and swallow.
Someone has bitten this silver coin before.
My hide is so thick I cannot grip it.

lines.zh: 落叶底下埋的东西，归我。
lines.en: Whatever is buried under the leaves is mine.
I carried it a while, then ate it.

lines.zh: 你进了我的林子，我看见你。
lines.en: You entered my woods, and I see you.
I start walking toward you, unhurried.

lines.zh: 八点伤害不高，但我不停。
lines.en: Eight points is not much, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 目标是你，后面那个也要。
lines.en: The target is you, and the one behind you too.
Your steps disturbed the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 你的汗味混着铁，隔着树都闻到。
lines.en: Your sweat and iron carry across the trees.
I lift my belly and begin the chase.

lines.zh: 这片林子只有一个出口。
lines.en: These woods have only one exit.
You are much easier to chase than a tree.
Once I pick, I do not switch.
When you run, I enjoy this more.

lines.zh: 我要把你拆成几份带走。
lines.en: I will break you into pieces to carry off.
At this distance, three steps is all I need.

lines.zh: 你回头看我的时候，腿就停了。
lines.en: When you look back at me, your legs stop.

lines.zh: 我尝到你呼吸里的味道。
lines.en: I taste the shape of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我把这一带的落叶都记下了。
lines.en: I memorized every leaf on this ground.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肚子擦着地。
lines.en: I lower myself, belly scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我算好了你后退的步数。
lines.en: I have counted the steps you will retreat.
You raise the sword; I wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 我绕到树后，从另一边出。
lines.en: I slip behind a tree and come out the other side.
I drool as I walk.

lines.zh: 你站在斜坡上，脚下不稳。
lines.en: You stand on the slope with unsure footing.

lines.zh: 我看你握剑的那只手，握得太紧。
lines.en: I watch the hand on your sword; it grips too hard.
Slowly now; prey always panics first.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的箭会滑开。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your arrow will glance off.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩一片落叶。
lines.en: Only a fallen leaf lies between us now.
I herd you toward the broken tree.
Your companion has already run.
Your sword is slow, and your feet slower.
One more step back and you are against the tree.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过来，一步也不让。
lines.en: I walk at you and yield no step.
You shove me and I do not even sway.

lines.zh: 我把你赶向那条干涸的沟。
lines.en: I herd you toward the dry gully.

lines.zh: 我贴得越来越近，皮都蹭到你。
lines.en: I close until my hide brushes yours.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小，可看得很死。
lines.en: My eyes are small but they do not let go.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我也换，慢了半拍。
lines.en: You turn; I turn, half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，用整个身子压。
lines.en: I lunge and crush you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 八点一下，我会给很多下。
lines.en: Eight points a hit, and I will land many.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进你的手臂，不松。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your arm and stay there.
You are knocked back half a step.

lines.zh: 我的爪子短，但够撕开皮。
lines.en: My claws are short, but they open skin.
That bite reached the bone.

lines.zh: 我撕下你袖子上一块皮。
lines.en: I tear a strip of leather from your sleeve.
You strike me, so I press in closer.
After the bite, I lick it.
Blood is salty, and I like it.
I hit you, and you hit the tree.

lines.zh: 这一口留了力，下一口不留。
lines.en: I held back this bite; the next I will not.

lines.zh: 你护甲的缝里全是牙印。
lines.en: Your armor seams are full of my tooth marks.
I swallow drool while I fight.

lines.zh: 我的牙卡在你的护肩里。
lines.en: My teeth lodge in your shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 这一爪撕开了你的腰带。
lines.en: This claw tears your belt open.

lines.zh: 我扑倒你，把重量全压上。
lines.en: I drop on you and put all my weight down.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我只是把头低下去。
lines.en: You slash me; I only lower my head.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小腿往后退。
lines.en: I bite your calf and pull backward.

lines.zh: 我的爪子磨过你的护胫。
lines.en: My claws grind across your greaves.

lines.zh: 我从赫尔维蒂的落叶里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of Lelyetia's leaf litter.
I was hungry from the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 橘色的皮先露出来，然后是我。
lines.en: First the orange hide shows, then the rest of me.
I opened my eyes under the roots.
Everything around is edible; I am pleased.

lines.zh: 我在一棵歪树下站起来。
lines.en: I stand up beneath a crooked tree.

lines.zh: 这身皮不是我的，是抢的。
lines.en: This hide is not mine; I took it.
My stomach woke up first.
I sniff the air; something is alive here.

lines.zh: 我把自己从土里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull myself out of the soil.
New Grobblers are always noisy.

lines.zh: 赫尔维蒂又多了一张嘴。
lines.en: Lelyetia has one more mouth now.
My hide catches fire and smells like roast meat.

lines.zh: 我肚子先着地，闷响一声。
lines.en: I land belly-first with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 呛了水，我还是把水咽了。
lines.en: I choke on the water and swallow it anyway.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚两圈，皮都焦了。
lines.en: The blast rolls me twice and scorches my hide.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的皮，像根牙签。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my hide like a toothpick.
That potion turns my stomach over.

lines.zh: 饿到极点，我连石头都想咬。
lines.en: Starving this badly, I would even bite stone.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整张皮都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole hide goes numb.
Nothing to eat in the void; that is the worst part.
